header.name: Trustworthy AI systems
header.description: Study the need for Trustworthiness of AI systems, and get an understanding of the role of various aspects such as fairness, bias, robustness, explainability, transparency, and ethical aspects of AI systems to create a Trustworthy AI system. Some of the algorithms to mitigate bias and algorithms on explainability of ML systems will also be studied.
prerequisites_mandatory: Artificial Intelligence (CSE643) / Machine Learning (CSE343/CSE543/ECE563) / Statistical Machine Learning (CSE342/ CSE542)

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Understand AI issues on Trustworthiness and Fairness

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Analyze an AI/ML system for its explainability, robustness and fairness and their lack thereof; evaluate AI systems numerically for explainability, robustness and bias/fairness

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Understand the role of AI systems in the context of Human Society and Trusted decision making

lecture_topics: Why AI Trustworthiness and its consequences are important
Some examples of why Trust is important and the issues to consider
Broad Principles of Trustworthinesss, Fairness, Accountability, Sustainability, and Transparency
Difference between each of these aspects
What is Bias and Types of Bias in AI systems
Identifying and mitigating bias in an AI system -- Various bias mitigation methods and algorithms
Fairness evaluation methods and algorithms - Algorithmic Fairness and other Fairness Methodologies
Accountability -- Accuracy, Reliability and Robustness aspects
Robustness of AI systems - methods and techniques
Reliability of AI systems - methods and techniques
Interpretability/Explainability in AI/ML – Traditional ways of explaining decisions made by AI/ML systems (First and second generation of Explainable AI)
Explanation of Linear classifiers by weights, Sparse models, Naive Bayes classifiers etc.

(Third generation of Explainable AI) Interpretability/Explainability in Deep Learning era – Blackbox/whitebox/Greybox techniques – In the area of image/video classification, fine grained classification, vision and language, autonomous driving etc.
Progressing towards the 4th generation of Explainable AI - Shadow models, Model inspection methods
CAM, Grad-CAM, Grad-CAM++, LIME, Guided LIME, and their algorithms
Formal methods for measuring/ ensuring robustness of AI/ML systems
Role of AI in Human Society and co-existence
Term paper presentation - Recent research papers read and presented by Students
